about_the_game:
Touch Grass is a brutal first-person parkour platformer set within a surreal, beautiful simulation, one designed by the mysterious tech corporation Nova Ascension, which aims to restore a climate-destroyed Earth.

Dash. Double jump. Wall run. Scream. 

Across 13 handcrafted levels and mind-breaking puzzles in an increasingly unstable digital world. There are no checkpoints. Every fall hurts. Every success matters.

But this isn’t just a test of sanity. It’s a test of survival. Nova Ascension has built a beautiful lie: floating islands, glowing crystals, dreamy skies, and comforting grass… all designed to keep you inside. To keep you from waking up.

Your only guide? A silent blue character named Bloop. He doesn’t speak. He doesn’t help. But when everything else breaks, he’s still there.

Inspired by Portal’s clean puzzles and Getting Over It’s relentless punishment, Touch Grass blends tight parkour movement with emotional storytelling and absurd humor in a world that’s trying very hard to keep you numb.

You’re not just escaping traps.

You’re escaping the system.

Be Reborn.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics or low-end GPU (e.g., Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Touch Grass is a brutal first-person parkour platformer set in a surreal, beautiful simulation created by Nova Ascension. Dash, double jump, and wall run through 13 unforgiving levels. No checkpoints. Just movement, madness, and the desperate need to escape.
